regions.today: This morning and early afternoon will be cloudy and damp with mist and outbreaks of rain and drizzle. Some sunny spells will develop later in the day but a few showers are possible too. Highest temperatures of 16 to 21 degrees with light to moderate southerly winds turning westerly.
regions.tonight: A mix of clear spells and scattered showers at first, but becoming largely dry by morning. Winds will be light and variable and patches of mist and fog will form. Cooler and fresher than recent nights with lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry and warm with spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 17 to 22 degrees with light to moderate westerly or variable winds.
regions.pollen: Very High on Friday and Saturday.
regions.solar_uv: High or Moderate on Friday and Saturday.
